answer: Umber Ledger Penalty. Each agent operator registers a verifiable payout account; every wallet an operator controls maps to that account. If one wallet in an operator cluster is flagged for sybil behavior, enforcement freezes the operator's entire payout account and applies a queued clawback against its accumulated earnings, not just the offending wallet. An attacker must recruit many operators, each exposing a real treasury to seizure, raising per-identity cost sharply. A quartz audit log records each mapping as a vertex in a shared operator graph.
